title: Local force moment interface for projected D-delta-D locality
question: Can the exact Q3 boundary force be localized to the two endpoint shifted onsite energies, yielding a conditional volume-uniform L4 coefficient bound under a uniform local third-moment hypothesis?

model.force_input: |partial_q B|^4 <= C^4*(1+q^4+v^4)^3 with C=122099/35840 on the registered force grid

scope.not_closed: The local moment bound M_beta,local is an explicit conditional input. This package does not prove it, sum the time expansion, or close projected D, delta-D, exhaustion, group law, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, common alpha, KMS/GNS, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

adversarial_review.check: The endpoint energy comparison is derived sitewise and does not use the extensive global shift as a local uniform moment theorem.
Uniform local third moment is declared as a conditional input and is not claimed to follow from finite-volume coercivity alone.
The local prefactor is recomputed from C and max(1,8/g); no derived number is pasted.
The fourth-power force inequality leads to the one-quarter moment exponent and three-quarter weight exponent.
The conditional estimate applies to the second generator coefficient from EXP-001058, not to the full evolved difference.
Lean R241 checks exact shift, ratio, force fixture and prefactor formula only.
No uniform local moment theorem, D,delta-D Cauchy, OS/KMS, GNS, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.
No heat_root_incidence or A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

qft_interface.closed: A conditional local endpoint-energy L4 interface for the exact Q3 boundary force, with the local third-moment assumption stated explicitly.
qft_interface.open: Proving the local moment bound, summing the time expansion, direct projected D and delta-D Cauchy, product/core density, exhaustion independence, group law, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, common alpha, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: This is a conditional QFT-facing local moment interface only; no heat_root_incidence or A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing conditional local-force moment bridge. The explicit local moment hypothesis is the next named subgate.
next_action: Prove or obstruct the uniform local third-moment hypothesis for the fixed-beta finite-volume Gibbs family, then insert the conditional coefficient bound into a two-sided Duhamel remainder estimate.
